apps.title: Ad blocking
apps.description: Block ads and trackers for every device on your network using DNS block-lists.

zh.title: 广告过滤
zh.description: 用 DNS 拦截列表为局域网内所有设备屏蔽广告和跟踪。

apps.title: DDNS
apps.description: Keep domain names pointing at your changing public address.

zh.title: DDNS
zh.description: 让域名始终指向变化的公网地址。

apps.title: Docker
apps.description: Run containers on the router: create, edit and open them, see their CPU and memory use, check for and apply image updates, search Docker Hub and download images, use a terminal, run Compose projects, manage images, networks, volumes and storage, and set a registry mirror.

apps.title: HomeProxy
apps.description: Route traffic through your proxy nodes and choose what goes direct.

zh.title: HomeProxy
zh.description: 通过代理节点转发流量，并决定哪些流量直连。

apps.title: Terminal
apps.description: Open a command line on the router in a browser tab.

zh.title: 终端
zh.description: 在浏览器标签页中打开路由器的命令行。
